PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 10; Write-Host "=== Health check after 10s warmup ==="; try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:18082/exchange/health" -TimeoutSec 3; Write-Host \("OKX Health: venue={0}, connected={1}, balance={2}, error={3}" -f $r.venue, $r.isConnected, $r.balance, $r.lastError\) } catch { Write-Host "QuantEngine management port not reachable yet: $_" })
